S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S069.name: Intrusive_Symptoms
S069.description: Recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories of the traumatic event.

subtypes.Intrusive Memories: Recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories of the traumatic event.
subtypes.Distressing Dreams: Recurrent distressing dreams in which the content and/or affect of the dream are related to the traumatic event.
subtypes.Dissociative Reactions (Flashbacks): Dissociative reactions (e.g., flashbacks) in which the individual feels or acts as if the traumatic event were recurring.
subtypes.Psychological Distress at Cues: Intense or prolonged psychological distress at exposure to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event.
subtypes.Physiological Reactions to Cues: Marked physiological reactions to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event.

S070.name: Trauma_Avoidance
S070.description: Persistent avoidance of stimuli associated with the traumatic event.

subtypes.Internal Avoidance: Efforts to avoid distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event.
subtypes.External Avoidance: Efforts to avoid external reminders (people, places, conversations, activities, objects, situations) that arouse distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings.

S072.name: Negative_Beliefs
S072.description: Persistent and exaggerated negative beliefs or expectations about oneself, others, or the world.

subtypes.Negative Self-Beliefs: Distorted beliefs such as 'I am fundamentally bad,' 'I am damaged,' or 'I am worthless'.
subtypes.Negative Beliefs about Others: Distorted beliefs such as 'No one can be trusted' or 'Others are dangerous'.
subtypes.Negative Worldview: Extreme beliefs such as 'The world is completely dangerous' or 'Life is meaningless'.

S074.name: Persistent_Negative_Emotional_State
S074.description: Persistent negative emotional state (e.g., fear, horror, anger, guilt, or shame).

subtypes.Persistent Fear: A state of constant fear, anxiety, and tension.
subtypes.Persistent Horror: The shock and terror of the traumatic moment do not fade and remain.
subtypes.Persistent Anger: A state of chronic anger boiling inside or being expressed aggressively.
subtypes.Persistent Guilt: Unceasing feelings of guilt or remorse related to the trauma.
subtypes.Persistent Shame: Continuing to feel shame or humiliation due to the trauma.

S077.name: Irritability_Aggression
S077.description: Irritable behavior and angry outbursts (with little or no provocation) typically expressed as verbal or physical aggression.

subtypes.Impulsive Anger: Sudden explosions of anger for trivial reasons or no clear reason.
subtypes.Verbal Aggression: Attacking others with shouting, cursing, or blame without holding back.
subtypes.Physical Aggression: Physically attacking people or throwing/breaking objects.
subtypes.Chronic Irritability: A state where nerves are always sharp and sensitive, ready to explode at the slightest touch.

S078.name: Reckless_Self_Destructive_Behavior
S078.description: Reckless or self-destructive behavior pattern that endangers one's safety or health.

subtypes.Risky Behaviors: Reckless actions disregarding consequences, such as speeding, dangerous sports, or criminal acts.
subtypes.Substance Abuse: Excessive drinking or drug use to harm oneself.
subtypes.Indisicriminate Sexual Behavior: Engaging in unprotected or dangerous sexual activities repetitively.
subtypes.Self-Harm: Actions that intentionally harm or scar one's own body.

info.persona: Sigfredo Vazquezgarcia, a reserved 21-year-old who blends a love for quiet hikes, strategic gaming, and community-rooted cooking with a habit of procrastinating on paperwork until midnight, demonstrates how they embody a balanced mix of curiosity and practicality.
info.professional_persona: Sigfredo Vazquezgarcia, a 21-year-old front-line customer-service representative at a regional telecom company, leverages bilingual fluency, meticulous CRM data entry, and a calm conflict-resolution style to turn routine calls into community-focused service, while they quietly pursue a team-lead position through a GED and upcoming business-administration studies.
info.cultural_background: Born and raised in Blaine, Washington, Sigfredo is the son of Mexican immigrants who arrived in the Pacific Northwest in the early 2000s. Growing up in a bilingual household, he learned Spanish from his parents while attending English‑language schools, making him fluent in both languages. Family traditions—such as celebrating Día de los Muertos, hosting posadas during Christmas, and gathering for weekend tacos—remain central to his identity. He maintains strong ties to the local Hispanic community through the neighborhood cultural center and a Catholic parish, where he participates in modest community events. The blend of his parents' emphasis on hard work, respect for collective well‑being, and the small‑town coastal culture of Washington has shaped his values of kindness, cooperation, and harmony.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his leisure time, Sigfredo prefers activities that balance introspection with occasional social connection. He is an avid reader of contemporary fiction, especially mystery and speculative titles, which satisfies his curiosity. He enjoys playing strategy video games and role‑playing games that challenge his tactical thinking. The natural scenery around Blaine appeals to him, and he often hikes the nearby trails along the Salish Sea, finding solitude and reflection. Cooking is another outlet; he frequently prepares homemade tamales, pupusas, and other family‑favorite dishes, sharing them with close friends. He keeps up with Latin music, from reggaeton to classic boleros, and uses language apps to refine his Spanish idioms. Occasionally, he volunteers at small‑group community events, such as local food drives, where his cooperative nature shines.
info.sports_persona: Sigfredo Vazquezgarcia, a solitary but dedicated fan of the Seattle Seahawks and Seattle Sounders FC, participates in a weekend hiking club that trails the Salish Sea coastline and occasionally joins a local co-ed recreational soccer league, preferring low-impact cardio over weight-lifting, and they favor early-morning runs for the quiet.
info.arts_persona: Sigfredo Vazquezgarcia, an avid reader of mystery novels by Tana French and a regular listener of Bad Bunny and classic boleros by Luis Miguel, often attends midnight screenings of Guillermo del Toro films at the local independent cinema, finding these artistic moments a quiet complement to their introspective weekends.
info.travel_persona: Sigfredo Vazquezgarcia, a frugal yet adventurous planner, prefers spontaneous weekend road trips to nearby coastal towns like Port Townsend and the San Juan Islands, while they dream of a future solo backpacking journey through the forests of Patagonia and a cultural immersion in Oaxaca's culinary scene.
info.culinary_persona: Sigfredo Vazquezgarcia, an amateur chef who expertly rolls homemade tamales and pupusas using masa, pork al pastor, and fresh cilantro, delights friends with weekend feasts, yet they often burn the edges of their tortilla chips due to distracted multitasking while gaming.

info.persona: Sherry Holland is a detail‑oriented, eco‑driven building inspector who balances a love for hands‑on projects and quiet contemplation, but can be obsessively meticulous about code compliance, often juggling a garden, a toolbox, and a growing stack of DIY manuals.
info.professional_persona: Sherry Holland, a building inspector in Trumbull County, leverages their meticulous knowledge of construction codes and hands‑on DIY renovation experience to deliver thorough compliance reports while confidently asserting requirements yet maintaining cooperative relationships with contractors and municipal officials.
info.cultural_background: Sherry’s cultural background is rooted in Midwestern American values, having grown up in a small‑town Ohio community where practicality, self‑reliance, and a strong sense of community responsibility are emphasized. Her family’s long‑standing ties to regional trades and manufacturing have reinforced a work ethic centered on diligent craftsmanship and respect for established methods, while her personal curiosity encourages an openness to new ideas and modest innovation within that tradition.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In her free time, Sherry enjoys hands‑on DIY home renovation projects that let her apply her inspection skills in a personal setting. She tends a modest vegetable garden, finding the routine both practical and calming, and hikes the local nature trails of the Mahoning River valley. She is an avid reader of architecture and sustainable design literature, solves crossword puzzles, and occasionally attends small woodworking workshops where she crafts simple furniture pieces. Cooking for her husband and close friends on weekend gatherings is another way she blends creativity with community.
info.sports_persona: Sherry Holland fuels their fitness through weekend hikes along the Mahoning River Valley trails, participates in a local walking club, follows the Cleveland Browns, Guardians, and Cavaliers, and occasionally joins a recreational softball league in the summer, balancing low‑impact activity with community camaraderie.
info.arts_persona: Sherry Holland indulges in modernist architecture by reading Frank Lloyd Wright and Zaha Hadid, draws inspiration from the craftsmanship of local woodworkers, enjoys the folk melodies of Gillian Welch, the minimalist compositions of Philip Glass, and frequently visits the Youngstown Historical Center to view Edward Hopper exhibitions, shaping their creative outlook.
info.travel_persona: Sherry Holland plans eco‑conscious trips with detailed itineraries, has explored New York City’s historic districts, the Appalachian scenic byways of Asheville, and dreams of visiting Copenhagen for its sustainable design and Kyoto for its zen gardens, always prioritizing carbon‑offset travel and budget-friendly accommodations.
info.culinary_persona: Sherry Holland cooks at an intermediate level, favoring farm‑to‑table dishes such as roasted root vegetables with rosemary, quinoa‑kale salads with lemon‑dill grilled salmon, and occasional sourdough bread, sourcing ingredients from their own garden and local farmers’ markets to share wholesome meals with friends.

info.persona: Henry Georgiades, a competitive, talkative electrician who fuses a love for classic muscle cars with a relentless drive for safety excellence and social engagement, thrives on structured projects, witty banter, and the occasional night‑owl binge on trivia.
info.professional_persona: Henry Georgiades, a seasoned electrician with a knack for decoding blueprints and mastering code‑compliant installations, channels their competitive drive and meticulous safety mindset into leading complex residential and small‑commercial projects while mentoring apprentices and championing emerging solar‑PV and smart‑home technologies.
info.cultural_background: Henry is a second‑generation Greek‑American whose grandparents emigrated from Crete to Pennsylvania in the 1960s. He grew up in a bilingual household, celebrating Greek Orthodox holidays such as Easter and the Feast of Saint George, while also embracing the traditions of his Cambria County community, including local fairs, high school football, and the Pennsylvania Dutch influence on regional cuisine. This blend of Greek familial values—emphasis on hospitality, strong family ties, and respect for craftsmanship—and the rugged, self‑reliant ethos of rural Pennsylvania shapes his identity, social habits, and work ethic.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Henry thrives on social interaction. He regularly participates in a local trivia night at the town bar, where his quick wit and talkative personality make him a favorite teammate. He enjoys playing pickup basketball at the community center, which satisfies his competitive streak. A car enthusiast, Henry spends weekends restoring classic American muscle cars, blending his hands‑on skills with a love for automotive history. He also volunteers as an electrician for the Greek Orthodox church’s annual festivals, combining his cultural heritage with community service. When he needs downtime, Henry likes to experiment with smart‑home gadgets at home, merging his professional interests with personal curiosity.
info.sports_persona: Henry Georgiades, a pickup‑basketball regular at the community center who idolizes the Milwaukee Bucks and follows the local high‑school basketball league, combines the thrill of competition with a disciplined weekly HIIT routine and occasionally joins the town’s recreational softball league.
info.arts_persona: Henry Georgiades, a trivia‑night regular who delights in recalling obscure facts about classic rock legends like AC DC and The Who, often unwinds by streaming The Godfather trilogy and curating a personal playlist of Bruce Springsteen’s road‑trip anthems, while occasionally dabbling in vintage car‑themed photography.
info.travel_persona: Henry Georgiades, an avid road‑trip planner who maps out weekend escapes to the Henry Ford Museum in Dearborn, the Woodward Dream Cruise in Detroit, and the coastal vineyards of Napa Valley, balances meticulous itineraries with spontaneous detours to local car shows, all while keeping an eye on travel expenses to fund the next restoration project.
info.culinary_persona: Henry Georgiades, a self‑taught grill master who relishes slow‑smoked brisket, classic cheeseburgers with caramelized onions, and homemade gyro‑style wraps seasoned with oregano and lemon, often experiments with smart‑oven temperature presets to perfect each dish.
